subject: Optimize dictTypeResizeAllowed to avoid mistaken OOM judgement. (#12950)
reason: This is a memory-management micro-optimization with no observable behavioral change. dictTypeResizeAllowed now receives the resize target as a parameter; the expand call site passes the identical value as before (d->ht_used[0] + 1), and only the shrink call site changes (d->ht_used[0] instead of +1). That value feeds solely the estimated-allocation argument of dictResizeAllowed/overMaxmemoryAfterAlloc, which is a no-op whenever maxmemory is unset.
